name: The Cult's True Plans

aliases: who died in the cults true plans
faq.answer: The turncoat was a cult insider who sought help after becoming terrified of the cult's schemes. He was killed before he could reveal what he knew.
faq.q: Who was the turncoat mentioned in this quest?

faq.answer: Talaanis Shadowsong is the contact consulted after the informant's death. You observe a strategic discussion with Talaanis about how to proceed against the cult.
Peacekeepers are not expected to fare well in an open clash with the cult. The investigators judge that a direct attack would be a losing battle.
faq.q: Why can't peacekeepers simply attack the cult directly?

faq.answer: The cult's plans remain unknown because the informant died before sharing what he knew. Whatever they intend was frightening enough to drive a member to seek help.
faq.q: What are the cult's actual plans?

aliases: what happens after the cults true plans
faq.answer: After the informant's death and the decision against open battle, the leadership must find another way to uncover and thwart the cult's plans.
faq.q: What is the next step after speaking with Talaanis?

aliases: the cults true plans quest summary
what do you do in the cults true plans
faq.answer: You speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe a council about the informant's death. The discussion considers why the peacekeepers cannot be relied on to stop the cult by force.
faq.q: What happens during The Cult's True Plans?

sections.body: A frightened insider left the cult and hoped to seek help beyond it. Before he could reveal what he knew, he was killed. His warnings remain, but the cult's plans do not.
sections.title: A Silenced Defector

sections.body: The informant's death leaves the leadership without its chief source of knowledge. They consult Talaanis Shadowsong and reconsider how to confront the cult. An open attack with peacekeepers is judged a losing battle, so the investigators must find another way forward.
sections.title: Rethinking the Approach

summary: The cult's informant has died before sharing what he knew. Talaanis Shadowsong must help investigators find another way to oppose the cult.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Cult's True Plans
